selection_boundary: Selected before manuscript rewrite from already-certified M11 CPCG collision results by requiring zero fine exact bounded overlap and positive CPCG projected overlap.
interpretation: CPCG makes an overlap appear by forgetting a temporal distinction retained by the working basis. Whether that coarsening is appropriate for capacity identity requires independent warrant.
prohibited_inference: Does not establish that conflict monitoring/control and episodic or semantic memory are the same capacity.
